title: Cattywampus Aquatic Adventures
specs: Spacious catamaran with over 960 sq ft deck, half shaded, half unshaded with nets
Safe, shallow swim sites for snorkeling
Family friendly for guests 0-99 years old
Private charters available for 2-49 people, suitable for birthdays, weddings, corporate trips
gap: Exact age minimum for snorkeling not stated
blurb: Guests join a 3-hour cruise that includes snorkeling at a safe, shallow swim site and dolphin watching in the Gulf of Mexico. The boat offers shaded and unshaded deck space with easy access for all ages. Private charters are available for special occasions with catering options.
extraNote: No food or drinks sold onboard; guests may bring their own cooler with drinks and snacks · Alcohol allowed only after swim portion on afternoon cruise
